completionEvidence.description: QMP screendump captured the XFCE desktop at 1280x800; xdotool getdisplaygeometry returned 1280 800.
After xrandr -s 1024x768, a new screendump header reported exactly 1024 768; the display was then restored to 1280x800.

notes: The MSYS2 QEMU build emits PPM for screendump even with a .png filename; the validation harness converts PPM to PNG. Guest Agent screenshot transport still needs its own implementation and authentication test.
